cards.name: Rivercourse Cold Water Conservation & Youth Fly Fishing Camp
cards.description: Campers learn fly fishing and fly tying, study stream ecology and cold-water conservation, and participate in hands-on conservation projects. Activities also include falconry, water safety instruction and outdoor games.

registration.text: Applications are being accepted starting January 2027

financial_aid.text: Financial sponsorship may be available through your local Trout Unlimited Chapter.

lunch.text: Comfortable, chaperoned accommodations with all meals provided in a beautiful dining setting

cards.review_notes: The homepage explicitly lists 2027 tuition of $1250, while the undated camper-fees page lists $995; the card uses the explicitly dated 2027 price. The application page still says 2026 is full; the homepage is used as the registration entry point because the destination of its girls/boys application links was not available in the supplied text. Venue address was obtained from the official Lake Logan contact-page search result.
